Downsampling.Description: Data were recorded at either 1024 Hz or 2048 Hz and subsequently downsampled to 1024 Hz by the data authors (Verwoert et al. 2022); method not reported

TaskDescription: Speech production of 100 unique Dutch words: one random word from the Dutch IFA corpus (extended with the numbers one to ten in word form) shown on a laptop screen for 2 s, read aloud once, followed by a 1 s fixation cross; about 300 s per participant (Verwoert et al. 2022, 'Experimental design'). Source sidecar text: 'Speech production of 100 unique Dutch words'.
Instructions: Speak the word presented on the screen out-loud
ElectrodeManufacturersModelName: Microdeep intracerebral electrodes (platinum-iridium; 0.8 mm diameter, 2 mm contact length, 1.5 mm inter-contact distance, 5-18 contacts per shaft)
iEEGPlacementScheme: Electrode locations were determined purely by clinical necessity
iEEGElectrodeGroups: sEEG shafts; contact names are shaft label + contact number
SourceManufacturerField: The source iBIDS sidecar listed Manufacturer 'BrainProducts'; the data descriptor states Micromed SD LTM amplifiers (Micromed S.p.A., Treviso, Italy), used here.
